dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent five 'O' shaped structures feature irregular, high-frequency scalloped perimeters. The gradient transition shifts abruptly from the dark primary coat to a 10-20 pixel wide light-grey boundary, which then encloses a low-intensity dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of low-intensity dark core pixels nested within light-grey annuli. The anterior region (far left) displays a high-concentration cluster of small, solid dark-pixel blobs that lack an internal light-to-dark gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest central-flank annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. Two vertically adjacent annuli on the mid-posterior dorsal line form a distinct linear pair.
